```{=html}
<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{SubsetSum}{$i,currentSum,remainingSum$}
\If{\(currentSum=W\)}\State report selection; \Return\EndIf
\If{\(i=n\lor currentSum&gt;W\lor currentSum+remainingSum&lt;W\)}\State\Return\EndIf
\State include \(w[i]\)
\State \Call{SubsetSum}{$i+1,currentSum+w[i],remainingSum-w[i]$}
\State undo include
\State \Call{SubsetSum}{$i+1,currentSum,remainingSum-w[i]$}
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
```
